title: Reversal learning across taxa
description: A presentation on reversal learning and a discussion on standardizing the MM1 task laid the groundwork for the study design.

title: Webinar series on reversal learning
description: Three open webinars covered reversal learning in primates (including humans), ungulates, rodents, fishes, marine invertebrates, birds, reptiles, and amphibians, helping current and prospective teams prepare to participate.

title: Open Research Methods fellowship call
description: Applications opened for a funded fellowship for graduate students and postdoctoral researchers to refine the MM1 study design and develop the experimental protocol and lab manual.

title: Open Research Methods fellows announced
description: Grace Blackburn, Christopher Shoukry, and Ben Whittaker were named as fellows to help finalize the study design and write the lab manual with the MM1 team.

title: MM1 lab manual published
description: The first version of the MM1 lab manual was published, covering the study rationale, research questions, target taxa, and practical procedures for testing and data collection.

title: Expressions of interest submitted
description: Research groups and labs submitted expressions of interest in collecting data for MM1.

title: MM1 study kickoff
description: The public study kickoff introduced the shared reversal learning protocol and explained how teams can register as contributing sites and collect data. A recording is available for teams joining the study.

title: MM1 Trial Logger developed
description: A web application was developed to streamline trial and demographic data collection across participating sites.

title: MM1 Study Calculator developed
description: The Study Calculator helps labs estimate the maximum number of trials, testing sessions, and subject-testing days their design may require. Teams can adjust parameters to understand the workload before collecting data.

title: MM1 data analysis team launched
description: The data analysis team began developing the analysis pipeline in R using simulated data.

title: Behavioral coding training with BORIS
description: Training covered setting up a BORIS project, coding MM1 behaviors with the ethogram, exporting data, and assessing inter-rater reliability to support consistent coding across labs.

title: Trial Logger supports sessions across multiple days
description: The Trial Logger now accommodates testing sessions spread across multiple days. For example, a lab can record up to 30 trials in three blocks of 10 across separate days.
